terra.problem: Saying there was no go-between or whisper in the king's ear rules out details the text does not address.
The text gives the journey's duration, but does not say they spent four months walking.
Saying Ezra lives the Law and then teaches it turns what he set his heart to do into completed actions and adds a sequence.
The text says the Law is in Ezra's hand, but calling that literal asserts a physical detail the wording does not establish.
Saying Ezra is holding the Law treats 'in your hand' as a physical detail the text does not establish.
The explanation is flat and repetitive, restating the answer without much of Papa Dorin's personality.
The letter gives Ezra and his brothers discretion; it does not say that the king trusts them.
The letter says to provide what Ezra requires promptly, but does not rule out a review or committee.
Saying the group never has to pay a toll goes beyond the letter's prohibition on imposing tribute, duty, or toll on them.
The explanation is flat and repetitive, with little beyond restating the answer.
